text:
Incident Bot: [P1] spike in 5xx from inference-prod-west — routing errors. Triggered by autoscaler flapping. Pager to primary.
Oncall Bot: Pager:INC-451 assigned to Alex C (primary)
Alex C: I’m on transit but still reachable for ~30m. If this escalates please handoff. ETA offline 02:15 UTC.
Maria S: I can take primary at 02:10 UTC — will shadow now. Alex, can you drop current runbook steps you did?
Alex C: quick notes: checked pods, saw restart loop on replica-set inference-serve-v2, scaled from 6 -> 3 then back; suspect rollout + kernel oom. Steps I ran:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference-serve -o wide
kubectl logs -n inference inference-serve-v2-7f9c -c inference
kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-serve-v2
``` 
Alex C: also added --eviction=false to the autoscaler temporarily (see runbook step 4)
Maria S: ok taking over primary in 5m. Samir can you be secondary for 02:10-06:00 UTC?
Samir K: yes I’ll be secondary. I’ll spin up an extra hot standby to reduce failover pain.
Samir K: bringing up canary nodes: `./infra/scripts/provision-standby --region=us-west --count=2`
Priya N: I can own customer comms if we need to notify impacted tenants. Which customers are affected?
Alex C: early indicators: heavy traffic from cust-dedicated-42 and two small PLG customers. Luis from Support looped in.
Luis (Support): I’ve opened tickets for cust-dedicated-42 and emailed their SRE lead. They are seeing 502s on long responses.
Incident Bot: Current impact: 14% of requests in us-west 15m window 5xx. No total outage. Automatic fallback to inference-prod-east triggered for 22% of requests.
Maria S: Runbook pointer: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/inference-5xx-spike — follow 'stabilize' section then 'rollback' if rollout suspected.
Maria S: I’m going to pin the serving image to v2.3.1 and stop the rolling update. Samir, hold scaling until I confirm.
Samir K: copied. Running command to pin image:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deployment/inference-serve-v2 inference=ghcr.io/redwood/inference:v2.3.1
kubectl set env deployment/inference-serve-v2 AUTOSCALER_ENABLED=false
``` 
Oncall Bot: Note: remember to remove temporary autoscaler env after stabilization. Tag: :warning:
Priya N: Drafting a short customer status message now, will post to customers impacted and to #support-ops. Ping me with any changes.
Maria S: Ok rollback completed, pods stable, 5xx rate dropping to 3% over last 5m. Samir, you can resume autoscaler in 10m if stable.
Samir K: resuming autoscaler in 10m, will watch. I'll keep secondary shadow until 06:00 UTC.
Alex C: thanks team — I’m stepping fully offline now. Maria — you’re primary until at least 06:00 UTC, Samir secondary, Priya owning comms.
Maria S: ack. leaving a short post-incident note in #postmortems later today. Good job. :thumbsup:
Luis (Support): customers updated. monitoring for escalations.
Oncall Bot: handoff recorded: primary=Maria S, secondary=Samir K, support=Luis, comms=Priya N. Handoff window 02:10-06:00 UTC.
Maria S: adding final checklist for whoever inherits later:
- confirm 5xx < 1% for 30m
- check autoscaler logs for flaps
- ensure rollout controller stable
- remove temporary env toggles
- follow incident runbook for RCA
Samir K: noted. I’ll keep the bridge open for 30m for any quick questions.
Incident Bot: INCIDENT-451 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Will close if stable for 1h.
Maria S: closing thread here, will update postmortem and assign owners for RCA. thanks all.
